framework_lessons: Delegate domain selection where expertise is limited.
assessment: The Bitcoin two-year outcome and AI research mechanism are supported. The stricter gold breakout was late, despite a correct bullish direction. BMY illustrates why cheap defensive stocks can disappoint while Amgen grows. The fiscal analysis correctly identifies interest costs and explicitly names the bill/RRP escape route, but overstates the necessity of early Fed monetization. Long healthcare horizons remain open.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
